row.evidence: Docker's pricing page lists 'Single Sign-On (SSO)' and 'SCIM user provisioning' under Docker Business ($24 per user/month, annual), while Docker Team ($15 annual) includes audit logs and RBAC but not SSO or SCIM.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM and SSO start at Business ($24/user/mo, annual only); Team $15 annual or $16 monthly, up to 100 users; Pro ($9 annual) is single-user. SCIM needs SSO configured first. SCIM 2.0 at the Docker Hub API (/v2/scim/2.0) with a bearer token from Docker Home; deprovisioning deactivates and removes the user from the organization (no SCIM DELETE). Roles, org and team via the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:docker:2.0:User extension; group push maps IdP groups named org:team to Docker teams. JIT is on by default and JIT values override SCIM. The Okta OIN 'Docker' app is marked SAML-only; Docker's guides use a custom SCIM app in Okta and a non-gallery app in Entra.

plans.name: Docker Pro
plans.notes: Maximum 1 user; no Docker Hub organization, so no org member API.

plans.notes: Up to 100 users, 1 organization, 10 organization access tokens.

plans.name: Docker Business
plans.notes: Monthly plan not offered ('–'); Buy now or Contact sales.

scim.notes: The exact SCIM Base URL is copied from Docker Home; the Hub API reference serves SCIM under https://hub.docker.com/v2/scim/2.0.

auth.token_source: Docker Home > Identity & auth > SSO and SCIM > SSO connection Actions > Setup SCIM (SCIM Base URL and API Token)

endpoints.notes: The Hub API reference documents Users (GET, POST, GET by id, PUT) only; no Groups path is listed even though group push is documented.

operations.notes: Deactivation is PUT with active=false; the API reference lists no DELETE or PATCH on Users. Group push and membership come from the group-mapping guide.

deprovision.data_retained: The Docker account itself remains (Docker IDs are personal); SCIM deactivates it in and removes it from the organization. Users added manually before SCIM must be removed by hand.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, sw, and, or, not, grouping; example filter on userName.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count; the OpenAPI count parameter has maximum 200.

custom.how: Docker extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:docker:2.0:User with dockerRole (member, editor, owner), dockerOrg and dockerTeam.

roles.how: dockerRole attribute in the Docker SCIM extension (member, editor, owner); teams via dockerTeam or org:team group mapping.

limitations.text: JIT values take precedence over and overwrite SCIM attribute values unless JIT is disabled.
SCIM cannot remove users who were added manually before SCIM was enabled.
Entra ID: SCIM and OIDC cannot share one non-gallery app; a second app is needed for SCIM.

user_api.notes: Organization member, invite and team endpoints in the Docker Hub API; organizations exist from Team up.

methods: bearer (from PAT or organization access token)

capabilities.notes: Members can be listed, exported, role-changed, removed from the org and invited in bulk; accounts themselves are created by users, not the org API.

endpoints.purpose: Add a member to a group
Remove a user from a group

rate_limits.text: Per-minute limits reported in X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded. Numbers not published.

okta.notes: OIN 'Docker' page marks only SAML (page markup) despite marketing text about provisioning; Docker's SCIM guide enables SCIM on the app created for SSO (custom app integration).

entra.notes: Docker's guide uses a non-gallery app for SCIM; no Entra gallery tutorial found (docker-business-*-tutorial URLs 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Auto-provisioning of existing Docker users by verified email domain
fallbacks.notes: JIT on by default for SAML and OIDC SSO connections. Bulk invites ('Add users in bulk') on Team and up.

conflicts.text: Okta OIN marketing text says the Docker integration covers 'enhanced user provisioning', but the OIN functionality list marks only SAML.

open_questions: Whether SCIM deprovisioning frees the paid seat immediately is not documented.
SCIM token expiry and rotation policy are not documented on the pages read.
SCIM Groups endpoint is not in the Hub API reference although group push is documented.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud SCIM support not documented by Docker.
